library(shiny) library(bslib) library(readr) library(dplyr) library(sf) library(leaflet) library(DT) library(htmltools) options(shiny.autoreload = FALSE) sae <- readr::read_csv("data/sae.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) indicator_metadata <- readr::read_csv("data/indicator_metadata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) palette_register <- readr::read_csv("data/palette.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) geography <- list( lga = readRDS("data/lga_geometry.rds"), state = readRDS("data/state_geometry.rds"), national = readRDS("data/national_geometry.rds"), state_labels = readr::read_csv("data/state_labels.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) ) stopifnot( dplyr::n_distinct(sae$indicator_id) == 15L, nrow(geography$lga) == 774L, nrow(geography$state) == 37L, nrow(geography$state_labels) == 37L ) `%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L) y else x format_percent <- function(x, digits = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "Not available", paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits), "%")) format_ratio <- function(x, digits = 3) ifelse(is.na(x), "Not available", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)) format_interval_percent <- function(lower, upper, digits = 1) paste0(format_percent(lower, digits), " – ", format_percent(upper, digits)) humanize_flag <- function(x) { mapping <- c( "NOT_APPLICABLE_STATE_AGGREGATE" = "Not applicable — State/FCT aggregate", "MODEL_DERIVED_AGGREGATE_FROM_FINAL_LGA_POSTSTRATIFIED_SURFACE" = "Model-derived State/FCT aggregate from the final LGA poststratified surface", "GOVERNED_CURRENT_DOM_CHILD_0_59_PROXY" = "Governed child 0–59-month population proxy", "YES_MODEL_BASED_EXTRAPOLATION" = "Yes — model-based extrapolation", "SHARED_CONDITIONAL_RECENT_FEVER_POPULATION" = "Shared conditional recent-fever population", "STATE_BY_RESIDENCE_CLASS_B_HOUSEHOLD_PROXY" = "State-by-residence Class B household proxy", "GOVERNED_DOM_TOTAL_POP_SUPPORT" = "Governed total-population support", "SURVEY_DERIVED_CONDITIONAL_CLASS_B_PROXY" = "Survey-derived conditional Class B proxy", "HIGH_DIRECT_TARGET_POPULATION" = "High direct target-population support", "INTERMEDIATE_HOUSEHOLD_PROXY" = "Intermediate household proxy", "LIMITED_CONDITIONAL_ELIGIBILITY_PROXY" = "Limited conditional-eligibility proxy", "APPROVED_YES" = "Approved", "CLASS_A" = "Class A", "CLASS_B" = "Class B", "SAMPLED" = "Sampled", "UNSAMPLED" = "Unsampled", "NO" = "No" ) vapply(as.character(x), function(value) { if (is.na(value) || !nzchar(value)) return("Not available") key <- toupper(value) if (key %in% names(mapping)) return(unname(mapping[[key]])) parts <- strsplit(value, "\\|", fixed = FALSE)[[1]] readable <- vapply(parts, function(part) { part_key <- toupper(part) if (part_key %in% names(mapping)) return(unname(mapping[[part_key]])) label <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(gsub("_", " ", part, fixed = TRUE))) label <- gsub("\\bLga\\b", "LGA", label) label <- gsub("\\bSae\\b", "SAE", label) gsub("\\bFct\\b", "FCT", label) }, character(1)) paste(readable, collapse = "; ") }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE) } build_hover_labels <- function(names, estimates) { unname(Map(function(name, value) htmltools::HTML(paste0( "", htmltools::htmlEscape(name), "
SAE estimate: ", format_percent(value) )), names, estimates)) } build_legend <- function(colours) { labels <- c("<20%", "20 - 40%", "40 - 60%", "60 - 80%", "80%+") rows <- paste0("
", labels, "
", collapse = "") htmltools::HTML(paste0("
Legend
", rows, "
")) } add_admin_overlay <- function(map, level) { if (identical(level, "LGA")) { map <- leaflet::addPolygons(map, data = geography$state, fill = FALSE, color = "#17365D", weight = 1.55, opacity = 1, options = leaflet::pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)) } map <- leaflet::addPolygons(map, data = geography$national, fill = FALSE, color = "#17365D", weight = 2.35, opacity = 1, options = leaflet::pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)) labels <- lapply(geography$state_labels$display_label, function(label) { htmltools::HTML(gsub("\\n", "
", htmltools::htmlEscape(label))) }) leaflet::addLabelOnlyMarkers( map, lng = geography$state_labels$lng, lat = geography$state_labels$lat, label = labels, labelOptions = leaflet::labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, direction = "center", textOnly = TRUE, className = "state-label"), options = leaflet::markerOptions(interactive = FALSE) ) } build_choropleth <- function(estimates) { level <- unique(estimates$geography_level) shiny::validate(shiny::need(length(level) == 1L, "Select one geography level.")) if (identical(level, "LGA")) { map_data <- dplyr::left_join(geography$lga, dplyr::mutate(estimates, geography_code = as.character(.data$geography_code)), by = c("grid3_lga_code" = "geography_code")) map_data$geography_code <- as.character(map_data$grid3_lga_code) } else { map_data <- dplyr::left_join(geography$state, dplyr::mutate(estimates, geography_code = as.character(.data$geography_code)), by = c("nmis_state_code" = "geography_code")) map_data$geography_code <- as.character(map_data$nmis_state_code) } if (sum(!is.na(map_data$estimate)) != nrow(estimates)) stop("Map-to-release geography reconciliation failed.") meta <- dplyr::filter(indicator_metadata, .data$indicator_id == unique(estimates$indicator_id)) palette <- dplyr::filter(palette_register, .data$palette_family == meta$map_palette_rule[[1]]) |> dplyr::arrange(.data$class_order) colours <- stats::setNames(palette$hex_colour, c("<20", "20 to <40", "40 to <60", "60 to <80", "≥80")) bounds <- sf::st_bbox(geography$state) leaflet::leaflet(map_data, options = leaflet::leafletOptions(minZoom = 5, maxZoom = 11, zoomControl = TRUE, attributionControl = TRUE)) |> leaflet::fitBounds(bounds[["xmin"]], bounds[["ymin"]], bounds[["xmax"]], bounds[["ymax"]]) |> leaflet::addPolygons( layerId = ~geography_code, fillColor = ~unname(colours[map_class_token]), fillOpacity = 0.9, color = if (identical(level, "LGA")) "#FFFFFF" else "#17365D", weight = if (identical(level, "LGA")) 0.55 else 1.35, opacity = 1, label = build_hover_labels(map_data$geography_name, map_data$estimate), labelOptions = leaflet::labelOptions(direction = "auto", sticky = TRUE, opacity = 1, className = "feature-hover-label"), highlightOptions = leaflet::highlightOptions(weight = 3, color = "#FFD166", bringToFront = TRUE) ) |> add_admin_overlay(level) |> leaflet::addControl(build_legend(colours), position = "bottomright", className = "nmis-legend-control") } build_estimate_table <- function(estimates) { out <- dplyr::transmute(estimates, Geography = .data$geography_name, `SAE Estimate (%)` = .data$estimate, `95% Credible Interval` = format_interval_percent(.data$lower_ci, .data$upper_ci), `Posterior CV` = .data$cv) if (!all(estimates$support_flag == "NOT_APPLICABLE_STATE_AGGREGATE")) out[["Sampled Support"]] <- humanize_flag(estimates$support_flag) if (!all(estimates$extrapolation_status == "NOT_APPLICABLE_STATE_AGGREGATE")) out[["Extrapolation"]] <- humanize_flag(estimates$extrapolation_status) estimate_column <- match("SAE Estimate (%)", names(out)) - 1L widget <- DT::datatable( out, rownames = FALSE, selection = "none", extensions = "Responsive", options = list(pageLength = 15, autoWidth = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, columnDefs = list(list( targets = estimate_column, render = DT::JS("function(data,type,row,meta){if(data===null||data==='')return '';if(type==='display'||type==='filter')return Number(data).toFixed(1)+'%';return data;}") ))), class = "stripe hover compact" ) DT::formatRound(widget, columns = "Posterior CV", digits = 3) } indicator_choices <- stats::setNames(indicator_metadata$indicator_id, indicator_metadata$official_indicator_name) method_card <- function(title, text) htmltools::div(class = "method-card", htmltools::h3(title), htmltools::p(text)) ui <- htmltools::tagList( htmltools::tags$head( htmltools::tags$meta(name = "robots", content = "noindex,nofollow,noarchive"), htmltools::tags$meta(name = "description", content = "Temporary technical demonstration of NMIS 2021 small area estimates") ), shiny::navbarPage( title = htmltools::div(class = "brand-lockup", htmltools::span(class = "brand-mark", "NMIS"), " Small Area Estimates"), theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5, primary = "#0B5D3B", secondary = "#123A63", bg = "#F5F7F6", fg = "#172321"), header = htmltools::tagList( shiny::includeCSS("www/app.css"), htmltools::div(class = "release-strip", htmltools::span(class = "year-badge", "NMIS 2021"), htmltools::span("Temporary technical demonstration of NMIS 2021 small area estimates")) ), shiny::tabPanel( "Explore estimates", htmltools::div( class = "page-shell", shiny::fluidRow( shiny::column(width = 3, htmltools::div(class = "control-card", shiny::selectInput("indicator", "Indicator", choices = indicator_choices, selected = "IND-001"), shiny::uiOutput("geography_ui"), htmltools::div(class = "control-note", "Click or tap an area on the map to keep it selected until you choose another.")), shiny::uiOutput("area_summary") ), shiny::column(width = 9, htmltools::div(class = "map-card", htmltools::div(class = "map-title-wrap", shiny::uiOutput("map_title")), leaflet::leafletOutput("map", height = "650px"))) ), shiny::fluidRow(shiny::column(width = 12, htmltools::div(class = "section-card", htmltools::h3("Area details"), shiny::uiOutput("area_details")))), htmltools::div(class = "section-card", htmltools::h3("Estimate table"), DT::DTOutput("estimate_table")) ) ), shiny::tabPanel( "About / Methods", htmltools::div(class = "page-shell", htmltools::div(class = "page-heading", htmltools::div(class = "eyebrow", "NMIS 2021"), htmltools::h1("About the estimates"), htmltools::p("A concise guide to this temporary browser-based technical demonstration.")), htmltools::div(class = "methods-grid", method_card("What SAE means", "Small area estimation combines survey information with a governed statistical model to produce estimates at approved geographic levels."), method_card("Point estimates", "The SAE point estimate is the primary displayed value. Display rounding does not change the governed source value."), method_card("Credible intervals", "The 95% credible interval describes posterior uncertainty and should be considered alongside posterior CV and support information."), method_card("Approved geography", "The 2021 release provides LGA SAE for 14 indicators. IND-011 is State/FCT-only. IND-008, IND-009, and IND-010 also have companion model-derived State/FCT products."), method_card("Data boundary", "This demonstration contains only minimized dissemination-level SAE fields and precomputed public map geometry. It contains no restricted NMIS microdata."), method_card("Demonstration status", "This is a temporary technical demonstration, not the permanent official public dissemination platform.")), htmltools::div(class = "section-card", htmltools::h3("Important use note"), htmltools::p("NMIS 2021 is the only enabled year. Cross-year comparison is disabled.")) ) ) ) ) server <- function(input, output, session) { available_geographies <- shiny::reactive({ shiny::req(input$indicator) levels <- unique(dplyr::filter(sae, .data$indicator_id == input$indicator)$geography_level) c("LGA", "State/FCT")[c("LGA", "State/FCT") %in% levels] }) output$geography_ui <- shiny::renderUI({ levels <- available_geographies() if (length(levels) == 1L) return(htmltools::div(class = "fixed-control", htmltools::span("Geographic level"), htmltools::strong(levels[[1]]))) shiny::selectInput("geography", "Geographic level", choices = levels, selected = levels[[1]]) }) selected_geography <- shiny::reactive({ levels <- available_geographies() if (length(levels) == 1L) levels[[1]] else input$geography %||% levels[[1]] }) filtered_estimates <- shiny::reactive({ shiny::req(input$indicator, selected_geography()) dplyr::filter(sae, .data$indicator_id == input$indicator, .data$geography_level == selected_geography()) }) selected_code <- shiny::reactiveVal(NULL) shiny::observeEvent(filtered_estimates(), { codes <- filtered_estimates()$geography_code if (is.null(selected_code()) || !selected_code() %in% codes) selected_code(codes[[1]]) }, ignoreInit = FALSE) shiny::observeEvent(input$map_shape_click, selected_code(as.character(input$map_shape_click$id))) selected_area <- shiny::reactive({ shiny::req(selected_code()) dplyr::filter(filtered_estimates(), .data$geography_code == selected_code()) |> dplyr::slice(1) }) output$map_title <- shiny::renderUI({ meta <- dplyr::filter(indicator_metadata, .data$indicator_id == input$indicator) htmltools::h2(class = "map-title", paste0(meta$official_indicator_name[[1]], " (", selected_geography(), ")")) }) output$map <- leaflet::renderLeaflet(build_choropleth(filtered_estimates())) output$area_summary <- shiny::renderUI({ x <- selected_area() htmltools::div(class = "summary-card", htmltools::div(class = "eyebrow", x$geography_level[[1]]), htmltools::h2(x$geography_name[[1]]), htmltools::div(class = "summary-label", "SAE point estimate"), htmltools::div(class = "summary-value", format_percent(x$estimate[[1]])), htmltools::div(class = "summary-foot", "NMIS 2021")) }) output$area_details <- shiny::renderUI({ x <- selected_area() rows <- list( c("SAE estimate", format_percent(x$estimate[[1]])), c("95% credible interval", format_interval_percent(x$lower_ci[[1]], x$upper_ci[[1]])), c("Posterior CV", format_ratio(x$cv[[1]])), c("Sampled support", humanize_flag(x$support_flag[[1]])), c("Extrapolation", humanize_flag(x$extrapolation_status[[1]])), c("Population support", humanize_flag(x$population_support_status[[1]])), c("Release geography", x$geography_level[[1]]), c("Population route", humanize_flag(x$population_route[[1]])) ) tags <- lapply(rows, function(row) htmltools::div(class = "detail-row", htmltools::span(row[[1]]), htmltools::strong(row[[2]]))) warning <- x$reliability_flag[[1]] htmltools::tagList(tags, htmltools::tags$details(class = "disclosure-details", htmltools::tags$summary("Scientific and release notes"), htmltools::p(x$unresolved_limitation[[1]]), htmltools::p(x$population_limitation[[1]]), if (!is.na(warning) && nzchar(warning)) htmltools::p(htmltools::strong("Release warning: "), humanize_flag(warning)))) }) output$estimate_table <- DT::renderDT(build_estimate_table(filtered_estimates()), server = FALSE) } shiny::shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

name: www/app.css
content: :root{--nmis-green:#0b5d3b;--nmis-blue:#123a63;--ink:#172321;--muted:#5c6b66;--paper:#fff;--line:#dce5e0}body{background:#f5f7f6;color:var(--ink);font-family:"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif}.navbar{box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(18,58,99,.12)}.brand-lockup{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em}.brand-mark{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--nmis-green);color:#fff;padding:.24rem .48rem;border-radius:.35rem;margin-right:.15rem;font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.08em}.release-strip{min-height:46px;background:#e8f3ed;border-bottom:1px solid #cfe1d7;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:0 max(18px,calc((100vw - 1320px)/2));color:#315447;font-size:.9rem}.year-badge{display:inline-block;color:#fff;background:var(--nmis-blue);border-radius:999px;padding:.25rem .65rem;font-weight:700}.page-shell{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 18px 48px}.control-card,.summary-card,.section-card,.map-card,.method-card{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(18,58,99,.055)}.control-card{padding:20px;margin-bottom:18px;position:sticky;top:18px;z-index:2}.fixed-control{margin-bottom:1rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.35rem}.fixed-control span,.form-label{color:#44534e;font-size:.86rem;font-weight:600}.fixed-control strong{border:1px solid #ced8d3;border-radius:.5rem;padding:.45rem .75rem;background:#f8faf9}.control-note{margin-top:14px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.45}.summary-card{padding:22px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#123a63,#0b5d3b);color:#fff}.summary-card h2{margin:.2rem 0 1.4rem;font-size:1.5rem}.eyebrow{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;opacity:.76}.summary-label{font-size:.84rem;opacity:.78}.summary-value{font-size:2.65rem;line-height:1;font-weight:800;margin:.35rem 0 1rem}.summary-foot{font-size:.82rem;opacity:.76}.map-card{padding:8px;overflow:hidden}.leaflet-container{border-radius:11px;background:#fbfcfb}.section-card{padding:22px;margin-top:22px}.section-card h3{color:var(--nmis-blue);margin-top:0}.detail-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:.58rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid #edf1ef}.detail-row span{color:var(--muted)}.disclosure-details{margin-top:14px}.disclosure-details summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--nmis-blue);font-weight:700}.nmis-legend-control{background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important}.nmis-legend{background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);border:1px solid #202020;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;color:#111;min-width:128px}.legend-title{font-weight:800;margin-bottom:7px}.legend-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:4px 0;font-size:12px}.legend-swatch{width:19px;height:14px;display:inline-block;border:1px solid #000;box-sizing:border-box}.page-heading{margin:10px 0 24px;max-width:780px}.page-heading h1{color:var(--nmis-blue);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.025em}.page-heading p{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.05rem}.methods-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}.method-card{padding:22px}.method-card h3{color:var(--nmis-blue);font-size:1.08rem}.method-card p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55}.map-title-wrap{padding:10px 12px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.map-title{margin:0;color:#17365d;font-size:1.18rem;line-height:1.35;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:-.01em}.feature-hover-label{max-width:230px;white-space:normal;color:#172321;font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.35}.leaflet-tooltip.state-label{color:#17365d!important;font-weight:700!important;font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.05!important;text-align:center!important;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;text-shadow:-1px -1px 0 #fff,1px -1px 0 #fff,-1px 1px 0 #fff,1px 1px 0 #fff;-webkit-text-stroke:.35px #fff;paint-order:stroke fill;pointer-events:none!important}.leaflet-tooltip.state-label::before{display:none!important}.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_filter{margin-bottom:.65rem}.dataTables_wrapper table.dataTable{width:100%!important}.dataTables_wrapper table.dataTable th,.dataTables_wrapper table.dataTable td{white-space:normal;vertical-align:top}@media(max-width:992px){.methods-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.control-card{position:static}.summary-card{margin-bottom:20px}.map-title{font-size:1.08rem}.leaflet-tooltip.state-label{font-size:9px!important}.navbar .navbar-nav{flex-direction:row!important;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.1rem .8rem;width:100%}.navbar .navbar-nav .nav-link{padding:.6rem .25rem}}@media(max-width:680px){.methods-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.release-strip{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;padding-top:8px;padding-bottom:8px}.summary-value{font-size:2.2rem}.map-title{font-size:1rem}.leaflet-tooltip.state-label{font-size:8px!important}.detail-row{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}html,body,.tab-content,.tab-pane,.page-shell{max-width:100%;overflow-x:hidden}}
